Government proposes welfare reforms to aid 'lost generation'

Former minister Alan Milburn has proposed a shake-up of welfare spending, aiming to divert funds from benefits towards job support programs. The reforms are intended to prevent a 'lost generation' of young people. Milburn's report suggests the proposed welfare overhaul could also be extended to individuals over the age of 25.
